references.text: The prophecy in Isaiah about leaders dressed in purple as a sign of their status, which mirrors how Jesus was dressed in purple as a form of mocking honor.
The psalm that prophetically describes how they divided the garments of the suffering one, which is reflected in the event with Jesus.
John's description of how the soldiers wove a crown of thorns and placed it on Jesus' head, parallel to Mark.
Matthew's account, which also describes how Jesus was dressed in purple and given a crown of thorns, similar to Mark.
Luke's description of how Herod and his soldiers mocked Jesus by dressing him in a splendid robe, parallel to the mockery in Mark.
